answer_validation: Each emitted class/pick is matched to the current answer file within the linter's 0.002 mm anchor tolerance. This text-only validation reuses the one complete STL lint run; it does not rerun the geometry analysis.

new_geometry_disposition.cable_catch_surfaces: Three sliver and three ledge readings are the functional retaining undersides of 3 mm stock hooks. The narrow projection sets the entry mouth; it is not a thin ordinary wall. Only the 4P section has the recorded physical fit acceptance.
new_geometry_disposition.tube_springs: Six 1.52 mm readings are the free scaled 4 mm tube spring arms; two 2.40 mm readings are the selected C2 spring arms. The answers cover only those flexures, with the 4 mm fit and all full-enclosure print behavior still unqualified.

c14_slope_disposition.classification: Source-derived slope misclassification, existing answer re-anchored.
c14_slope_disposition.source_reason: _above_core_shell.c14_rear_cutters extrudes the measured inlet _body_profile through the rear wall; that profile has 4.85 mm lower 45 degree chamfers. In the ceiling-down print these become the roof corners of a through-opening, grown from the opening sides, rather than corbels running along a standing wall.
c14_slope_disposition.alternatives: Read through-opening roofs separately; squaring the profile gives a flat roof over the measured chamfered body.

retained_answers_scope: Existing unrelated answers, including any entries explicitly marked outside scope and unresolved, keep their original status. This review grants no blanket acceptance to those features.
